items.title: Acorn and Leaf Garland
items.alt: A wide shallow curved twig garland carries a row of hanging acorns and small green gold oak leaves.
items.description: A wide shallow curved twig garland carries a row of hanging acorns and small green gold oak leaves. An original acorn illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.
